class Inventory:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = {}

    def add_item(self, name: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if quantity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("quantity must be positive")

        current_quantity = self.items.get(name, 0)
        self.items[name] = current_quantity + quantity

inventory = Inventory()
inventory.add_item("Keyboard", 12)
inventory.print_report()
